referenceName: Institutional animal hospital with public education and specialty pathways

source.name: Schwarzman Animal Medical Center official website
source.sourceType: official direct animal-hospital and nonprofit website, captured in Playwright Chromium
source.rightsEvidence: Requester-attested clearance on 2026-09-29 covers retaining the paired desktop/mobile full-page captures, deriving a design prompt, and using these captures as internal pipeline-model visual references. No source-owner grant was supplied.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: This animal medical center uses layered utility navigation for pet owners, the veterinary community, and supporters. Its opening is a full-bleed clinical-team photograph with a calm serif statement and a single focused path. Two editorial feature stories introduce institutional work, then a colored public-education field presents resources as paired text-image modules. A compact three-item latest-news strip leads into a deep-blue social-image chapter, newsletter form, and dense charcoal sitemap. The visual grammar is civic and institutional rather than boutique: wide horizontal bands, clear access paths, credible staff context, and serif headings against clean sans-serif utility. Adapt the layered audience structure and editorial chapter rhythm only; all dates, awards, credentials, research, statistics, staff, addresses, imagery, and source claims are excluded unless separately verified for the client.

heroGeometry.mode: full-width clinical-team photograph with a brief overlaid statement
heroGeometry.viewport: two utility navigation levels above a single opening message and action

navigationGeometry.mode: institutional utility bar plus audience switcher
navigationGeometry.mobile: brand with a compact menu; expose emergency/contact separately when relevant

typography.scale: moderate title with strong section labels and compact utility copy

palette.contrastIntent: information-dense navigation and education stay readable with clear hierarchy

imageTreatment.mode: documentary team and animal-care images paired with editorial feature cards
imageTreatment.crop: wide opening crop followed by consistent landscape and square crops
imageTreatment.focalPoint: keep people and patients visible; preserve room for hero title

servicePresentation.pattern: specialty and care pathways organized as an information atlas, not a sales card grid
servicePresentation.interaction: audience and service links lead to distinct detail, appointment, or referral routes

ctaPlacement.primary: urgent contact or appointment according to the verified practice
ctaPlacement.early: a single direct action appears within or just below the hero

motion.primitive: small news and social image carousel controls
motion.library: native CSS or framework primitives; no source code
motion.reducedMotion: show an ordered static row and keep all content in the document

mobileRecomposition.strategy: compress utility navigation, then sequence image, action, feature stories, education, and news vertically
rules: keep urgent contact distinctly available when clinically applicable
stack paired editorial features without shrinking body copy
turn latest updates into an accessible vertical list
retain sitemap groups as compact accordions with expanded-state semantics

prohibitedPatterns: copying institution wordmarks, team or patient photos, staff identities, awards, accreditation, research claims, ratings, or copy
implying specialty credentials or hospital capacity without client proof
burying practical care access under donor and education content
recreating inaccessible dense desktop navigation on mobile
using source content as medical advice

requiredSignatureElements.description: When the client serves genuinely distinct audiences, a compact utility system makes their routes clear without crowding the main navigation.
The first supporting chapter pairs a small number of image-led feature stories with explanatory text.
A distinct educational section provides useful visitor guidance linked to confirmed services.

acceptanceChecks: The hero action remains visible at standard desktop and mobile viewports.
Visitor care access is not subordinated to institutional or editorial material.
Only verified client audiences, capabilities, credentials, figures, research, and impact claims appear.
Mobile utility navigation has no horizontal overflow and retains keyboard access.
All source staff, patient imagery, marks, wording, and claims remain untransferred.

review.notes: Official page returned HTTP 200. Both full-page captures show the multi-tier navigation, team hero, editorial features, educational area, news, social photography, form, and footer. Mobile document width measured 392 px at a 390 px viewport; screenshot is viewport-cropped to 390 px and the 2 px source overflow is noted. One third-party source script error occurred. No source imagery is used as client media.
